meta.title: Sell Lemons powers data

sources.label: Roblox badges API - Sell Lemons universe
Pro Game Guides - Sell Lemons Beginner's Guide

uncertainFacts: Exact unlock conditions are not source-verified for Manage, Run Faster, Stack Upgrades, Expert Picker, Speed Up Time, or Forever Purchase. Rows use Needs in-game check instead of guessed unlocks.
Remote Buy is reported by selllemons.com as unlocking at Evolution 6 with trevigintillion-level Investors, but it still needs direct in-game confirmation after recent game updates.
Forever Purchase is reported to preserve one selected purchase across Rebirths, Evolutions, and Ascensions. Exact power persistence behavior for the other powers still needs in-game verification.
No acceptable direct power UI screenshots were found in the research pass, so row image fields stay empty.

items.name: Manage
items.effect: Opens remote management for income sources so you do not have to walk back to every building.
items.bestUse: Use it when the tycoon spreads across multiple sources and walking between buildings starts slowing upgrades.
items.resetNote: Check power availability after major resets before routing around it.
items.cardSummary: Manage is the remote-control power. It matters once your run has enough active sources that walking back to each one wastes time.
items.verificationNote: Effect is listed on selllemons.com and broadly supported by selllemons.wiki Manage panel context. Exact unlock condition and reset behavior need direct in-game check.

items.name: Run Faster
items.effect: Increases character movement speed across the map.
items.bestUse: Use it for travel between distant income sources, phone offers, map pickups, and newly unlocked zones.
items.resetNote: Check power availability after major resets before routing around it.
items.cardSummary: Run Faster is a travel power. It does not change income math directly, but it saves time whenever the run asks you to move.
items.verificationNote: Effect is listed on selllemons.com. Exact unlock condition and reset behavior need direct in-game check.

items.name: Expert Picker
items.effect: Raises the value of fruit and money-bag pickups around the map.
items.bestUse: Use it when you are already collecting map pickups during travel or waiting for time-based income.
items.resetNote: Check power availability after major resets before routing around it.
items.cardSummary: Expert Picker makes scattered pickups more meaningful. It is best when map movement is already part of your run.
items.verificationNote: Effect is listed on selllemons.com. Pro Game Guides supports money bags as a real quick-time cash source. Exact unlock condition and reset behavior need direct in-game check.

items.name: Stack Upgrades
items.effect: Lets upgrade effects stack together instead of only replacing the previous effect.
items.bestUse: Use it once repeat upgrades and global multipliers are doing more for the run than one-off purchases.
items.resetNote: Use it for upgrade effects during the current rebuild, then recheck after major resets.
items.cardSummary: Stack Upgrades is the compounding power. It matters when repeated upgrades and multiplier layers are driving the run.
items.verificationNote: Effect and strategy importance are listed on selllemons.com. Exact unlock condition, stack math, and reset behavior need direct in-game check.

items.name: Speed Up Time
items.bestUse: Use it when timers, managers, or delayed payouts are already producing enough value to be worth accelerating.
items.resetNote: Best checked after timers and managers are already worth accelerating.
items.cardSummary: Speed Up Time is the timer power. It is strongest when your active systems already have meaningful timed output.
items.verificationNote: Effect is listed on selllemons.com. Its paid Skip Time gamepass interaction is a caveat, not a power row. Exact unlock condition and reset behavior need direct in-game check.

items.name: Remote Buy
items.effect: Lets you purchase upgrades remotely without visiting each building.
items.bestUse: Treat it as deep endgame convenience after Evolution and investor scaling make map-wide rebuilding the main chore.
items.resetNote: Built for late rebuilds where walking to every purchase is the bottleneck.
items.cardSummary: Remote Buy is the endgame buying shortcut. It should not distract early or midgame players because it belongs to very deep progression.
items.verificationNote: Effect and reported requirement come from selllemons.com. The exact unlock requirement should be verified directly because the game is young and has recent updates.

items.name: Forever Purchase
items.effect: Makes one selected purchase permanent across major reset loops.
items.bestUse: Save it for a purchase that keeps helping every rebuild, such as a strong global multiplier target.
items.resetNote: Preserves one selected item across major reset loops; extra slots are tied to Ascension progress.
items.cardSummary: Forever Purchase is the reset-routing power. Its value comes from choosing one purchase that keeps paying off after the run resets.
items.verificationNote: Effect and reset behavior are listed on selllemons.com. The recommended 42x Global Cash target needs exact in-game label verification before being treated as a firm public instruction.
